Title: Project setup, CI and linting
Acceptance Criteria: Django 5 project with PostgreSQL settings via environment variables | GitHub Actions runs flake8 and tests on every PR | Branch protection: PR with one review required on main

Title: Authentication, roles and access control
NFR / Constraints: NFR-SEC1, NFR-SEC2, NFR-SEC3, NFR-SEC4, NFR-SEC5, NFR-SEC11
Acceptance Criteria: Login and logout with salted-hash passwords | Roles: Donor, Staff, Hospital User, Administrator | Server-side permission check on every view | Password policy, 5-attempt lockout for 15 min, 30 min session timeout

Title: Base layout and role-based navigation
Acceptance Criteria: Header, role-scoped left nav, footer, responsive down to 360px | Field-level error display and error banner standard

Title: Donor registration and unique donor ID
Acceptance Criteria: Form captures all REQ-1 fields incl. consent timestamp | Donor ID generated as DNR + 8 digits, immutable, shown on confirmation

Title: Registration validation (duplicates and age)
Acceptance Criteria: Duplicate mobile or email rejected with the exact SRS message; nothing persisted | Age outside 18-65 rejected with the exact SRS message

Title: Medical history and permanent deferral
Acceptance Criteria: Declared permanent-deferral condition marks donor Permanently Deferred | Temporary conditions recorded with review date

Title: Eligibility engine
Acceptance Criteria: Checks age, weight >=50kg, Hb >=12.5, systolic 100-140, 90 days since last donation | Reports every failing criterion, not only the first

Title: Collection guard and next-eligible date
Acceptance Criteria: Collection blocked for non-Eligible donor with reason and review date | Next eligible date = last donation + interval; expired deferral auto-clears

Title: Record donation and unit ID with barcode
Acceptance Criteria: Donation event stores donor, datetime, volume, bag lot, site, staff | Unit ID BU + 10 digits, printable label with barcode

Title: Unit state machine and quarantine
Acceptance Criteria: New units are Quarantined and excluded from availability, issue and reservation | Unit model holds all REQ-16 attributes and status set

Title: Screening results, release and discard
Acceptance Criteria: All five tests required before release | Available only if all Non-Reactive; any Reactive discards and alerts admin | Donor identity in alert restricted to admin

Title: Audit log for status transitions
Acceptance Criteria: Immutable record per status transition with user, time, reason | No edit or delete path through any view or admin

Title: Inventory console: stock counts
Acceptance Criteria: Available counts by blood group and component | Reflects committed changes within 5 seconds

Title: Inventory filters, transfer and manual discard
Acceptance Criteria: Combined filters on group, component, location, status, expiry range | Transfer logs source, destination, user; discard needs reason and confirmation; Issued units cannot be discarded

Title: Auto-expiry and near-expiry alerts
Acceptance Criteria: Scheduled job moves expired units to Expired at least every 24h | Units within 7 days of expiry flagged; daily digest to staff

Title: Component separation
Acceptance Criteria: Parent split into PRBC, plasma, platelets with own IDs and expiry | Children linked to parent and donor; parent closed

Title: Hospital raises blood request
Acceptance Criteria: Request ID REQ + 8 digits; urgency Routine/Urgent/Emergency | Non-positive quantity and past required-by rejected with field-named message

Title: Request queue, approve and reject
Acceptance Criteria: Queue ordered Emergency first then required-by ascending | Reject requires reason communicated to hospital

Title: Allocate, issue and fulfilment status
Acceptance Criteria: Only Available, exact-group, unexpired units allocatable | Reserve atomically on allocation, Issued on confirmation with full record | Fulfilled vs Partially Fulfilled with shortfall

Title: Cancel request
Acceptance Criteria: Hospital cancels own Pending or Approved request; reservations released | Blocked once any unit is Issued

Title: Camps: create, list and enrol
Acceptance Criteria: Camp create with future-date and time-range validation | Donor listing by date; enrolment refused with next eligible date if ineligible

Title: Camp collection link and closure
Acceptance Criteria: Units carry camp ID as collection site | Close camp shows actual vs target and blocks further collections

Title: Availability search for hospitals
Acceptance Criteria: Counts by group and component only; no unit or donor identifiers for hospital users

Title: Notifications: dispatcher, reminders, shortage appeal
Acceptance Criteria: Async SMS and email with 3 retries then email fallback | Eligibility and 24h camp reminders; shortage appeal max once per 30 days

Title: Reports, export and data scoping
Acceptance Criteria: Six reports over a date range per Appendix B.7 | PDF and CSV export with name, range, user, timestamp | Hospital users see only own data

Title: Admin: users, hospitals and configuration
Acceptance Criteria: Create, modify, deactivate users with exactly one role; register hospitals | Configurable thresholds (interval, age, weight, Hb, shelf lives) without code change

Title: Safety rule tests and concurrency hardening
Acceptance Criteria: Negative tests: untested, expired, wrong-group units cannot be issued | Concurrent allocation of same unit test passes

Title: Security, quality and performance hardening
Acceptance Criteria: CSRF, escaping, parameter binding verified | Line coverage >= 70%, screen render under 3s at P95

Title: Documentation, deviations log and demo video
Acceptance Criteria: Deviations from SRS, SAD and Test Plan documented | 1-minute and 2-minute sprint videos uploaded to repo
